### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/verify`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts`, `packages/spec/src/automation/schedule-organization.zod.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**17** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0f1eeeeeb754fc7bbfe64d89e2a305048a75ac7c`.

⛔ **12** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts`, `packages/spec/src/automation/schedule-organization.zod.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **154** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0f1eeeeeb754fc7bbfe64d89e2a305048a75ac7c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `453e82eaa8b378effbaada2d4b0cb905492c8082` — the merge of head `0a71e50d7229d1b13564c89da4dcbb8a3c65b347` into base `0f1eeeeeb754fc7bbfe64d89e2a305048a75ac7c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 453e82eaa8b378effbaada2d4b0cb905492c8082 && git checkout 453e82eaa8b378effbaada2d4b0cb905492c8082
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0f1eeeeeb754fc7bbfe64d89e2a305048a75ac7c 0a71e50d7229d1b13564c89da4dcbb8a3c65b347 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0f1eeeeeb754fc7bbfe64d89e2a305048a75ac7c && git merge --no-ff 0a71e50d7229d1b13564c89da4dcbb8a3c65b347

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0f1eeeeeb754fc7bbfe64d89e2a305048a75ac7c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0f1eeeeeb754fc7bbfe64d89e2a305048a75ac7c` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0a71e50d7229d1b13564c89da4dcbb8a3c65b347`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/automation/schedule-organization.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.driver-read-scope-follows-tenant-wall.ts, packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.sharing-rule-declared-mirror-retired.ts + packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts (cited), packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-position.object.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/translations/{en,zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.objects.generated.ts, packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts (cited), packages/objectql/src/engine.ts (cited), packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts (cited), packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts and email-service.ts (cited), packages/services/service-automation/src/suspended-run-store.ts (cited), docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md (cited), packages/spec/scripts/liveness/empty-state-registry.mts and check-empty-state.mts, packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/organization-ownership.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts, packages/verify/src/harness.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/delivery-claim-tenant-audit.integration.test.ts, content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx, content/docs/references/automation/schedule-organization.mdx, .changeset/25203-adr-0131-small-carriers.md

Inputs read: card #25203 (body, seat notes 6339857021 / 6342226941 / 6345275520, claim 6346494581, dev report 6347774192); plan amendment 6254164222 on #15212 for item 1's rule only; PR #25266 body, file list (20 files, +96/−50) and the net diff against merge base `8010b641c9`; the check-runs on the head. Not read: the dispatch order, the seat's conclusions.

### ① Derived judgments

**Item 1 — the one behaviour change, `resolveDeclaredRuleScopes` (`sharing-plugin.ts:96-139`).**
- The walk now ends on `read.length < DECLARED_RULE_ORGANIZATION_PAGE` (rows READ, :136); a page where `page.length !== read.length` — an `id` that is not a non-empty string — warns and answers `null` (:128-134). This is the rule amendment 6254164222 prescribes ("compare the raw page length, and treat a filtered-out id as a failed read (→ `null`)"). Right.
- Every caller treats `null` as unknown: the sole caller is `sharing-plugin.ts:821-823` — `declaredScopes ? setDeclaredRuleScopes(declaredScopes) : setDeclaredRuleScopesUnknown()`. `setDeclaredRuleScopesUnknown` (`sharing-rule-service.ts:544-553`) sets `declaredScopes = null`, a state of its own: no declared rule is served, `sweepOrphanedRuleGrants` revokes no declared rule's grant, and `addDeclaredRuleScope` (:559-566) keeps unknown unknown. No second consumer of the return value exists (grep at head). Right.
- Happy path byte-identical to the base: with every id a non-empty string `page.length === read.length`, so `read.length < 500` is the old `page.length < 500`; `ids` and `after` are built exactly as before; `find` call counts are unchanged (1201 rows → 3 calls, 1000 rows → 3 calls, an empty table → one call answering `[]`); a non-array `rows` reads as `[]` and returns `ids` as before. The sibling pins "reads every organization past the former 500-row cap", "a page boundary that lands exactly on the last organization still ends the walk" and "`single` reads nothing" stand unchanged. Right.
- The pin, `sharing-rule.test.ts` "a FULL page holding a row with no readable id answers unknown (null) …": 1201 organizations, the first page (no `where`) returns row 10 with `id: undefined`. Ablation reasoning: under the base block that page keeps 499 ids, `499 < 500` ends the walk and the function returns a 499-element array, so `toBeNull()` fails — red without the fix; the dev's measured ablation (1 failed / 5 passed, restore blob equal to `HEAD`) agrees. The warn assertion matches the new message. Right.
- Not reachable under the shipped schema (`sys_organization.id` is a text field): hardening, as the amendment says. The new warning names a remedy and carries no tracker number. `resolveDeclaredRuleScopes` is not re-exported from `plugin-sharing`'s `index.ts`, so no public surface moves; the fix rides as `patch`. Right.

**Item 3 — the retired NULL-means-global texts.**
- `sys-user-position.object.ts` (docblock :19-21, help :111) and `sys-user-permission-set.object.ts` (help :113): TRUE against `grantAppliesInTenant` (`resolve-authz-context.ts:876-878`: `organizationId !== null && organizationId === tenantId`) and its docblock (:840-874: "A row with none (`null`) applies NOWHERE … organization-less grant is invalid state rather than a 'global' one"); `grantOrganizationOf` (:914-924: "`null` confers nothing"); both `sys_user_position` (§4, :1565) and `sys_user_permission_set` (§6, :1650, :1705) ask that one rule; the platform anchor reads only an organization-OWNED `admin_full_access` grant (:1624, :1651). ADR-0131 D1 amendment: "nothing reads a NULL tenant value as an owner". The position docblock's D1 citation is right. `explain-engine.ts` carries no `organization_id` predicate any more (one comment, :359). Right.
- Translations: the `en` values equal the two new `description` strings byte for byte (the shape the repo tool writes; `check:i18n` on the head is the mechanical confirmation, under ③). `zh-CN` (授权 / 分配) and `ja-JP` (付与 / 割り当て) distinguish grant from assignment as `en` does; `es-ES` renders both as "asignación" — same meaning (belongs-to, no NULL arm), one word less precise for the grant. Not a contract defect; noted below for the seat.
- `SendEmailInput.organizationId` TSDoc (`email-service.ts:77-84`, the `IEmailService` input): TRUE. The writer is `EmailPersistence.insert` → `engine.insert(object, row, { context: SYSTEM_CTX })` (`email-plugin.ts:532-535`; `SYSTEM_CTX` carries no `tenantId`), so `Engine.resolveSystemInsertOrganization` (`engine.ts:8017-8070`) decides: `derived` → stamped; `no-organization-object` → `undefined`, row unstamped; otherwise `SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError`. That is ADR-0131 D9 and its 2026-10-22 lean-embedding note; "the one organization it can derive" is the `single` install's one organization (`system-write-organization.ts:54-58`). Right.
- `verify/harness.ts` `inviteForAudienceGate` comment: TRUE — D8 "nothing under `single`", D11 "only whether the wall is enforced differs". Not published (`files: dist`; a comment inside `bootClaimed`'s body).
- Forced companion, `empty-state-registry.mts` (−10): the row classified the exact statement "NULL = applies in every org context" that item 3 removes. `check-empty-state.mts` is two-way (`empty-state.mts:324-328`: forward ratchet "a permissive-empty statement with no entry fails"; reverse rot "STALE — registered, but the statement is gone"), so with the statement gone the row has nothing to classify and keeping it reds the gate; deleting it weakens nothing — the forward ratchet still fails any permissive-empty statement with no entry. Its rationale ("the distinguishing input to the highest privilege") was already false at head (the anchor reads the Default Organization's row, :1624). `Spec property liveness`, which runs `check:empty-state` (`spec-liveness-check.yml:61-62`), is `success` on the head. Right.

**Item 2 — wording.**
- `18.sharing-rule-declared-mirror-retired.ts` `reason`: TRUE against D13's closing sentence, "Each retirement of an authorable shape is an ADR-0087 entry". The amendment's suggested text named a card number; the `reason` ships in `protocol-upgrade-guide.md`, so dropping it follows the runtime-string rule and the sentence carries the reason instead. Right.
- `18.driver-read-scope-follows-tenant-wall.ts` `surface`, "update and delete by id or by predicate": TRUE — `update()` passes `recordedVerdict: opCtx.tenantLayer0Verdict` to `buildDriverOptions` on its predicate branch (`engine.ts:18576`) and its by-id branch (:18751); `delete()` on the by-id pre-read (:21463, `where: { id: targetId }`), the predicate branch (:21614) and the by-id branch (:21633); `driverReadScope` (:7818-7860) projects the verdict to `{ tenantId, tenantIds? }`. Right.
- CLI warning (`organization-ownership.ts:635`) and the two comments: TRUE against `heldUnattributable` (`organization-ownership-apply.ts:3808-3809`: `notNullExempt ? 0 : table.unattributable.length`) — unattributable rows hold certification except on a table whose column is not the tenancy anchor. A runtime string with no tracker number. Right.

**Item 6 — `schedule-organization.zod.ts` TSDoc and its regenerated page.** TRUE: `ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore` (class at `suspended-run-store.ts:293`) stamps the paused row's `organization_id` as `organizationOf(ctx.object, ctx.record) ?? ctx.tenantId ?? null` in `serialize` (:960). The `.mdx` hunk equals the `.zod.ts` hunk — regenerated, not hand-edited. Right.

**Item 7 — `tenant-audit-census.mdx` gate order, item 2.** TRUE against `engine.ts:7757-7759` (`isTenantAuditInScope = resolveTenantFieldName(objectSchema) !== null && !isFederated`) and :7776-7798 (`isSystem && opts.bypassTenantAudit === undefined && !isTenantAuditInScope` → `bypassTenantAudit = true`; an explicit caller value is honoured). Right.

**Item 8 — `delivery-claim-tenant-audit.integration.test.ts` (7+/3−).** The hunk lies entirely inside the file-header comment. `auditedUpdateMany` (:68) still matches the opening `[tenant-audit] updateMany on tenant-scoped object "…"` and the positive control (:113-115) is unchanged. No assertion weakened. Right.

**Tracker numbers in shipped text.** A sweep of every added line in the net diff finds one, `(#10103)`, in the `resolveDeclaredRuleScopes` docblock — a code comment carried over from the base, not a runtime string. No new shipped text carries one. Right.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/25203-adr-0131-small-carriers.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/spec`; `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none`. The PR body carries the same two lines.
- `Clause-②: no` with no parenthetical is a well-formed value: AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3 reads "plus AT MOST one arm from the closed pair", so zero arms is allowed, and `no` is right — no accept set moves. Every spec hunk is TSDoc or a semantic entry's prose (`surface` / `reason`): no `.describe()` value, no key, no refinement; the two `plugin-security` `description`s are help text, not validation. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right (nothing an author can write changed), and `none` takes `patch`. The `plugin-sharing` behaviour change is a bug fix on a released package: `patch`, in the same changeset. Right.
- Coverage: spec (ships `src/**/*.zod.ts` verbatim, the `.d.ts` TSDoc and the upgrade guide), plugin-security (object `description`s are runtime values, plus the four bundles), cli (the printed warning), plugin-sharing (behaviour plus a warning) — all four named. `@objectstack/verify` (`files: dist`): its only change is a comment inside a function body, which neither the `.d.ts` nor the built output carries — nothing published moves, no changeset owed. `@objectstack/service-messaging`: a test docblock only — none owed. Right.
- `Check Changeset` on the head: `success`.

1. Attribution line links the card thread — the harness-written requester block; the PR body's footer is the session-URL form AGENTS.md prescribes for a body; the four commits carry the model-free trailer pair. Accepted. `Implemented-by:` below is the branch the claim 6346494581 names.

3. Item 2a text without the card number — the runtime-string rule; the text stays true to D13 (① above). Accepted.
4. `empty-state-registry.mts` row deleted — the reverse-rot consequence of removing the statement it classified, not a gate weakened (① above); the gate's check-run is green on the head. Accepted.
5. `main` moved 2 commits, not merged in — AGENTS.md §10 merges `main` only on a reported conflict, a main-caused red or a queue removal; the PR is `mergeable: true`. Accepted.

`open_questions`: none declared; none found.

Out-of-scope items, named and disposed: item 4 landed with #25210 (seat note 6339857021); item 5 is a `.claude/**` line (governed) routed to the skills lane — named, no carrier card cited; items 9 and 10 (seat note 6345275520) wait on #25246 and stay on this card. **Escalated to the seat, outside the contract face:** the PR body reads `Fixes #25203`, so merging closes the card while items 5, 9 and 10 are undelivered; the review checklist asks `Part of #25203` when only the implementable part lands, or a named carrier for each remaining item before the card may close. A body edit — the head does not move and this record stands.

Gates the dev left to CI, read on the head: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is hosted by ci.yml `Build Core` (:2710); `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-coverage` by lint.yml `Type Check · consumer gates` (:6557, :6574). Conclusions at posting: `Build Core` `success`, `Type Check · consumer gates` `success` — both families green on this head.

Check-runs on `0a71e50d7` at posting (2026-10-22T18:43Z): 42 completed — 36 `success`, 6 `skipped` (`18.x upgrade harness (opt-in)`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard)`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` — opt-in or full-battery lanes, not PR gates), 0 `failure`, 0 in progress. The five required contexts — `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` — are all `success`. `Check Changeset`, `Spec property liveness`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card` and `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` are `success`.

- `es-ES` renders the permission-set grant's help as "esta asignación" where `en`, `zh-CN` and `ja-JP` say grant — same meaning, a one-word polish if the lane wants it.
